head: codex/96-v3-umbrella-receipt-topology
title: [v0.92][C-SDLC v2][blocker] Reconcile umbrella receipts with v3 source-evidence topology
body:
Closes #96

## Summary
- validates exact historical S, E, H, merge, and umbrella-candidate Git topology for all sixteen WP-04 children
- preserves full ordinary-blob product immutability, evidence-prefix introduction and immutability, derived terminality, split repository authority, and the frozen dependency DAG
- validates canonical generic and WP-04.16 proof receipts, including exact nonzero tests, nested runners, ordered RFC3339 timestamps, logs, artifacts, negatives, and macOS/Linux/Windows native receipts
- supports the bounded real #5863 legacy v2 refresh topology without accepting collapsed or self-referential receipts

## Validation
- focused generated-history regression: 34 cases passed, including representative current #5863 legacy and split-repository shapes
- Ruby syntax checks: passed for validator and regression
- full git diff check: passed
- typed C-SDLC validation and doctor: passed at implemented generation 7
- independent exact-head security/correctness review: passed at 652cb88d7e196858491e28f57c73bdd36449ebde with no actionable findings

## Boundary
- no runtime or distributed product files changed
- the live sixteen-child merged terminal manifest remains the future umbrella integration proof; this PR repairs and proves the validator without accepting unmerged children
